title: Number of Transactions per Visit
prompt: Count how many visits had 0, 1, 2, 3... transactions. Return transaction_count and visits_count, including missing buckets up to the maximum transaction count.
expected_query: WITH RECURSIVE per_visit AS (SELECT v.visit_id, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM visits v LEFT JOIN transactions t ON v.visit_id = t.visit_id GROUP BY v.visit_id), max_bucket AS (SELECT MAX(transaction_count) AS max_count FROM per_visit), buckets(transaction_count) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT transaction_count + 1 FROM buckets, max_bucket WHERE transaction_count < max_count), visit_counts AS (SELECT transaction_count, COUNT(*) AS visits_count FROM per_visit GROUP BY transaction_count) SELECT b.transaction_count, COALESCE(vc.visits_count, 0) AS visits_count FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN visit_counts vc ON b.transaction_count = vc.transaction_count;
explanation: First count transactions per visit, then generate every bucket from 0 to the max count. LEFT JOIN the real counts and COALESCE missing buckets to zero.
hints: Use LEFT JOIN so zero-transaction visits survive.
Generate bucket numbers with a recursive CTE.
common_mistakes: Using INNER JOIN and losing zero-transaction visits.
Counting amount instead of transaction rows.
